common_intent_requirements.text: 透明杯里装着已分层的水和食用油
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 透明杯里装着已分层的水和食用油
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a transparent cup on a level tabletop. Clear water forms the lower layer and edible oil forms the upper layer, with a readable boundary between them.
A hand gently rocks the cup once through a small movement, creating a mild wave at the interface, then sets the cup steady again.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍出它们逐渐恢复上下分层的样子
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍出它们逐渐恢复上下分层的样子
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The water remains mainly below the oil, and the wavering boundary gradually becomes calmer and more clearly separated into upper and lower layers.

physics_checks.criterion: 轻微扰动后，两种液体仍呈可辨的相分离趋势，食用油主要位于水的上部。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 起始层次、晃动后的界面波动和静置阶段的上部油相可辨。
fail_examples: 原本清晰可见的油相在没有流出或其他处理时整体消失
油相无外力整体沉到清水下面并稳定停留
两种液体直接互换颜色和位置而无连续流动
not_required: 允许残留小液滴和短时混浊
不要求十二秒内达到完全平整界面或精确层厚

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
